regressionRuns.name: account deletion and support budget follow-up

interpretation: The 25-, 33-, and 32-test runs overlap and are separate reruns, not cumulative coverage counts.
The earlier 142-test run is also overlapping historical evidence and must not be added to later counts.
Initial setup failed because the fixture inserted the singleton instance_settings row twice; no support-case test body ran in that attempt.
Earlier expiry fixtures violated the database retention binding; the final fixture sets a short future expiry and waits on actual PostgreSQL time before checking exclusion and erasure.
Earlier server typechecks exposed an ActivityPublication wrapper mismatch; the corrected source passed the final server typecheck.

The 142-test and 32-test runs precede the native publication fix; the 33-test run includes the actual company live-event assertion and erased-request replay fence. The 25-test run adds strict text/Unicode validation.
limits: The authenticated embedded-Postgres runs use explicit test-only support policy values and do not prove operator production values are configured.
No configured external SupportCaseGateway or delivery acknowledgement is qualified; customer receipts remain local and delivery-pending.
Provider-side deletion, real legal-hold process, marker expiry, backup restoration horizon, and hosted customer/operator acceptance remain open.
